messages:
maya: FYI — onboarding sample-app fails on Deno Deploy / Cloudflare Pages after we switched to conditional exports. Error from Deno: "no suitable export found for './package.json'" and TS can't find typings in the edge bundle. Anyone seen this?

liam: Can you paste the package.json exports you shipped?

maya: Yep, minimal repro (package.json):
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/sdk",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
    }
  },
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```
But Deno/Workers won't resolve the types via that top-level "types" alone — they expect either an export subpath for types ("./types") or explicit re-exports. Also some edge runtimes reject conditional exports patterns unless you include a fallback path.

jess: I ran into this last month. Short fixes: add an explicit types subpath in exports and a wildcard mapping. Example: add "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" and/or "./*": "./dist/*". Keeps deno/edge happier.

samir: Note another parity gotcha: the ESM bundle we publish uses global fetch and a smaller middleware chain, which means the auth/retry behavior differs. Sample-app saw silent 401s (no retry) when running the ESM/edge bundle vs the CJS node SDK where retries kick in. We need regression tests for auth+retry across both builds.

maya: Ugh — OK. Plan suggestions? I can add a repro in sample-app.

liam: Proposed action items:
- Add explicit types export: "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" under exports.
- Add a wildcard export mapping ("./*": "./dist/*") to cover some tooling that resolves subpaths differently.
- Add a tiny CI matrix job that installs the package and runs the sample-app in node 18 (CJS), node ESM, Deno, and wrangler (Cloudflare Workers) to catch runtime resolution issues.
- Add a smoke test that asserts auth/retry behavior (stub upstream to return 500 then 200, ensure SDK retried once).

jess: Also document the recommendation: edge runtimes should prefer the ESM bundle but consumers must ensure their bundler/runtime supports conditional exports. Add a short note to sample-app README to reduce onboarding friction.

publish-bot: publish job queued for 1.12.3 — build matrix will include esm+cjs+types verification once PR lands. :robot_face:

maya: Assigning: @liam -> exports change + package.json tweaks; @samir -> CI smoke tests + auth/retry integration; I'll update sample-app README and add the repro.

liam: Got it, opening PR today. Will include tests and the export changes.

samir: I'll add a small fast end-to-end that runs the sample-app against a tiny mock server to exercise retries and 401 flows.

jess: Thanks — this should cut a lot of onboarding noise. :thumbsup:

maya: niftily short: once PR merged, I'll run a local Deno/worker smoke run and sign off.

liam: will post PR link here when ready.
